violations.text: Protective shielding is not provided for the lights in the back prep area. Light bulbs must be shielded, coated, or otherwise shatter-resistant in areas where there is exposed food; clean equipment, utensils, and linens; or unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. PIC said shielding arrived yesterday and needs to be installed. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026
